description: Baldur's Gate 3 Mod Studio Tooling Registry

categories.authoring: Mod authoring, stat generation, progression curves, and asset scaffolding
categories.packaging: Pure Python LSPK .pak archive building and game data deployment
categories.diagnostics: Static validation, conflict detection, handle auditing, and save file inspection
categories.management: Load order management, version bumping, metadata generation, and setup
categories.library: Mod.io API search, archive synchronization, and community mod database queries
categories.theorycrafting: Combat DPR simulation, multiclass spell slots, and build mechanics

tools.name: create_mod_scaffold.py
tools.summary: Scaffolds a complete Baldur's Gate 3 mod directory structure.
tools.description: Generates a fully compliant mod directory tree under my_mods/<ModSlug> with Projects, Mods, Localization, and meta.lsx with proper GUIDs and Version64.

flags.name: mod_name
flags.description: Mod name in PascalCase or slug form

examples: python3 scripts/create_mod_scaffold.py ArcaneWeapons --author "CustomAuthor" --description "Adds custom arcane weapons"

tools.name: scaffold_stat_entry.py
tools.summary: Scaffolds Larian stat entries with automatic localization handle allocation.
tools.description: Generates 100% engine-compliant stat boilerplate for Weapon, Armor, Amulet, Ring, Object, PassiveData, Status_BOOST, and Spells, allocating Larian string handles and appending to Localization XML.

flags.name: --mod
flags.description: Mod directory name in my_mods/ or path

flags.name: --type
flags.description: Stat type: weapon, armor, amulet, ring, object, passivedata, status_boost, spell_target, spell_shout, spell_projectile, spell_zone

flags.name: --using
flags.description: Base stat entry to inherit from

examples: python3 scripts/scaffold_stat_entry.py --mod arcane-progression --type weapon --name WPN_ArcaneStaff --display-name "Arcane Staff" --description "Empowered staff." --props "Rarity=VeryRare,Damage=1d8,Damage Type=Bludgeoning" --json

tools.name: scaffold_progression_node.py
tools.summary: Scaffolds and merges Larian XML Progression and SpellList nodes into BG3 mods.
tools.description: Discovers and injects progression nodes into Progressions.lsx and companion SpellLists.lsx, automatically resolving vanilla TableUUIDs for all 12 classes without crashing the level-up screen.

flags.name: --mod
flags.description: Mod directory name in my_mods/ or path

flags.name: --class
flags.description: Base class name (Fighter, Wizard, Rogue, Paladin, etc.)

flags.name: --passives
flags.description: Semicolon or comma separated list of passives

flags.name: --boosts
flags.description: Semicolon or comma separated list of boosts

tools.name: scaffold_root_template.py
tools.summary: Binds stat entries to in-game 3D RootTemplates in Public/<Mod>/RootTemplates/_merged.lsx.
tools.description: Generates 3D visual item GameObjects linking visual mesh presets, collision physics, and string handles into _merged.lsx so items have visible models in-game.

flags.name: --mod
flags.description: Mod directory name in my_mods/ or path

flags.name: --visual-preset
flags.description: Visual preset: greatsword, longsword, dagger, shortbow, staff, plate, leather, robe, helmet, boots, gloves, cloak, amulet, ring, backpack

flags.name: --list-presets
flags.description: List all built-in visual mesh presets

tools.name: inject_treasure_table.py
tools.summary: Injects custom mod items into BG3 treasure tables and vendor inventories.
tools.description: Appends item drops to standard game containers (Tutorial Chest, Camp Chest) or vendor inventories via TreasureTable.txt subtables with drop counts and drop chances.

flags.name: --mod
flags.description: Mod directory name in my_mods/ or path

flags.name: --item
flags.description: Item stat entry name to drop

flags.name: --container
flags.description: Target container alias: tutorial_chest, camp_chest, vendor_act1, vendor_grove, vendor_goblin

tools.name: generate_icon_atlas.py
tools.summary: Calculates UV coordinates and generates GUI/Icons.lsx for custom BG3 icons.
tools.description: Calculates exact normalized UV coordinates ([U1, V1, U2, V2]) and generates GUI/Icons.lsx texture atlas definitions for custom item and spell icons.

flags.name: --mod
flags.description: Mod directory name in my_mods/ or path

tools.name: generate_compat_patch.py
tools.summary: Scaffolds compatibility patches or Compatibility Framework configs for colliding BG3 mods.
tools.description: Compares conflicting mods and generates automated reconciliation patches as standalone merge mods or Compatibility Framework JSON payloads with configurable merge strategies.

flags.name: --mod1
flags.description: First conflicting mod name or path

flags.name: --mod2
flags.description: Second conflicting mod name or path

flags.name: --mode
flags.description: Patch output format: standalone or cf (compatibility framework)

flags.name: --patch-name
flags.description: Custom name for generated patch mod

flags.name: --dry-run
flags.description: Simulate patch generation without writing files

examples: python3 scripts/generate_compat_patch.py --mod1 unlocklevelcurve --mod2 choose-your-stats --strategy merge_all --format standalone --json

tools.name: pack_mod_pak.py
tools.summary: Pure-Python LSPK v18 .pak package builder for Baldur's Gate 3 mods.
tools.description: Packages mod source directories into Larian Package v18 (.pak) archives with zlib compression, eliminating external C# LSLib binaries or Wine on Linux/WSL.

flags.name: --mod
flags.description: Mod directory name in my_mods/ or path

flags.name: --verify
flags.description: Verify archive integrity with LspkArchive after packing

tools.name: sync_to_game_data.py
tools.summary: Syncs custom BG3 mods from my_mods/ to Steam Baldurs Gate 3/Data directory.
tools.description: Deploys mod assets (Projects, Mods, Public, Localization) directly into the game's active Data directory so changes are detected immediately in-game and by the Toolkit.

flags.name: --mod
flags.description: Specific mod to sync (defaults to all in my_mods/)

flags.name: --data-dir
flags.description: Explicit Steam BG3 Data directory path

flags.name: --bump-build
flags.description: Increment mod build version before syncing

flags.name: --dry-run
flags.description: List files that would be copied without copying

flags.name: --clean
flags.description: Clean target mod folders before copying

tools.name: validate_mod.py
tools.summary: Deterministic static validator and linter for BG3 mods.
tools.description: Validates LSX XML syntax, verifies localization string handle integrity, checks asset dependencies, and audits mod structure for engine compliance.

flags.name: --mod
flags.description: Mod directory name in my_mods/ or path

tools.name: check_mod_conflicts.py
tools.summary: Static entry collision and compatibility analyzer for BG3 mods.
tools.description: Detects stat entry collisions, progression level overlaps, and console-incompatible native DLLs between candidates and tracked library mods.

flags.name: --against-library
flags.description: Compare candidate against all tracked mods in library.md

flags.name: --all
flags.description: Run pairwise collision matrix across all tracked mods

flags.name: --summary
flags.description: Output high-level collision counts and mod pairs without dumping full raw entries

tools.name: sync_localization.py
tools.summary: Audits, prunes orphaned string handles, and syncs multi-language localization XMLs.
tools.description: Cross-references localization handles against all stat and LSX files, pruning unused orphans with .bak backups and synchronizing multi-language skeletons.

flags.name: --mod
flags.description: Mod directory name in my_mods/ or path

flags.name: --check
flags.description: Audit check mode for missing handles and orphans

tools.name: inspect_save_game.py
tools.summary: Inspects BG3 .lsv save files and audits them against active mod load orders.
tools.description: Extracts mod load order dependencies and character metadata from BG3 .lsv save archives and cross-references against modsettings.lsx to identify crash sources.

flags.name: --save-file
flags.description: Path to .lsv save file (defaults to most recent save)

flags.name: --audit
flags.description: Audit save mod dependencies against active profile modsettings.lsx

tools.name: manage_load_order.py
tools.summary: Inspects, activates, and validates Baldur's Gate 3 mod load order in modsettings.lsx.
tools.description: Lists active mods in modsettings.lsx, activates or disables installed mods, and validates load order consistency and missing UUID dependencies.

flags.name: --list
flags.description: List all active mods in modsettings.lsx (default action)

flags.name: --enable
flags.description: Enable and append mod by name or UUID to load order

flags.name: --disable
flags.description: Disable and remove mod by name or UUID from load order

flags.name: --validate
flags.description: Validate load order against installed mods and report inconsistencies

tools.name: bump_mod_version.py
tools.summary: Auto-generates and bumps semantic versions and Larian Version64 integers in BG3 mods.
tools.description: Calculates and encodes 64-bit uint Version64 integers across Projects/<UUID>/meta.lsx and Mods/<UUID>/meta.lsx atomically according to semantic versioning.

flags.name: --mod
flags.description: Mod directory name in my_mods/ or path

flags.name: --show
flags.description: Display current version and encoded Version64 without bumping

tools.name: generate_mod_metadata.py
tools.summary: Exports a custom mod README as HTML for publication.
tools.description: Reads a mod's root README.md and renders the full document as modio_description.html.

flags.name: --mod
flags.description: Mod directory name in my_mods/ or path

flags.name: --json
flags.description: Emit structured output paths as JSON

tools.name: modio_update_metadata.py
tools.summary: Previews and updates metadata and selected profile settings for a local BG3 mod on mod.io.
tools.description: Uses MODIO_PAT to update a uniquely matched published mod's HTML description, approved additive tags, three Community options, non-commercial credit options, and public visibility. Preview is read-only; writes require --confirm.

flags.name: --mod
flags.description: Exact mod name or slug for a folder under my_mods/

flags.name: --tags
flags.description: Comma-separated user-approved tags; may be repeated

flags.name: --confirm
flags.description: Perform writes after interactive user confirmation; without it, preview only

tools.name: setup_environment.py
tools.summary: BG3 Mod Studio & Mod.io Toolkit Environment Setup Wizard.
tools.description: Verifies Python version, inspects Steam BG3 and AppData directories, creates workspace directories, and checks mod.io API authentication.

flags.name: --check-only
flags.description: Check environment and paths without interactive prompts

tools.name: query_mod_database.py
tools.summary: High-speed BiS gear, spell, and mechanics database query engine.
tools.description: Indexes all cataloged community mods in mods/ into a sub-10ms cache (.cache/mod_database.json), allowing instant querying by slot, boost, passive, rarity, or keyword.

flags.name: --slot
flags.description: Filter by gear slot: Weapon, Armor, Helmet, Boots, Gloves, Cloak, Amulet, Ring, Shield

flags.name: --boost
flags.description: Search in stat Boosts (e.g. SpellSaveDC, AC, Ability)

flags.name: --search
flags.description: Free text search across name, displayName, and description

flags.name: --rarity
flags.description: Filter by rarity: Common, Uncommon, Rare, VeryRare, Legendary

flags.name: --mod
flags.description: Filter items to a specific mod slug

flags.name: --compact
flags.description: Output compact records omitting raw file paths and empty fields

tools.name: update_library_catalog.py
tools.summary: Updates or checks six-column categorized catalog in mods/library.md from mods/*/README.md.
tools.description: Parses verified mod.io IDs, titles, directory slugs, descriptions, and implemented-feature counts from README specs in mods/<slug>/ and compiles categorized six-column rows with relative spec links in mods/library.md. Unknown IDs stay blank.

flags.name: --check
flags.description: Check if library.md is up to date without writing

tools.name: modio_search.py
tools.summary: Searches Baldur's Gate 3 mods on mod.io with platform and tag filtering.
tools.description: Queries the mod.io REST API for Baldur's Gate 3 mods, supporting natural language queries, platform targeting, and pagination.

flags.name: --platform
flags.description: Target platform: windows, mac, xboxseriesx, ps5, console

flags.name: --include-tracked
flags.description: Include mods already cataloged in mods/library.md

tools.name: modio_sync.py
tools.summary: Syncs BG3 mods/library.md with your mod.io subscribed mods.
tools.description: Downloads and unpacks subscribed or requested mods from mod.io into mods/<slug>/, generating documentation specifications.

flags.name: --skip-updates
flags.description: Skip checking for mod version updates

tools.name: modio_update.py
tools.summary: BG3 Mod Documentation Update Checker & Pipeline.
tools.description: Checks tracked mods in mods/ against remote mod.io releases to identify version updates and refreshes documentation.

flags.name: --all
flags.description: Check all tracked mods in library.md

flags.name: --list-tracked
flags.description: List all tracked mods and current versions

tools.name: modio_extract.py
tools.summary: Fetches, unpacks, and parses BG3 mods from mod.io.
tools.description: Parses LSPK .pak archives, extracts internal files, generates rich documentation specs, and indexes mod capabilities.

flags.name: --mod-id
flags.description: Mod.io ID to download and unpack

tools.name: simulate_build_synergy.py
tools.summary: Theorycrafting simulator for Level 20 BG3 character builds and mod gear synergies.
tools.description: Simulates Turn 1 combat sequences (melee burst, eldritch blast) with advantage, critical chance, and damage riders, calculating Spell Save DC ceilings and multiclass slot matrices.

flags.name: --gear
flags.description: Comma-separated item names to equip and analyze

flags.name: --dpr-sequence
flags.description: Turn 1 combat sequence: melee_burst or eldritch_blast

tools.name: diagnose_toolkit_logs.py
tools.summary: BG3 Toolkit runtime message log diagnostic, triage, and workspace correlation tool.
tools.description: Auto-discovers and parses live and session logs from the BG3 Toolkit (Glasses.exe). Classifies engine asserts, design errors, and subsystem failures (Boosts, Stats, Thoth, Osiris, RootTemplates), correlating errors back to local mod files in my_mods/.

flags.name: --type
flags.description: Subsystem log type: engine, osiris, thoth, personal, network, all (default: engine)

flags.name: --severity
flags.description: Minimum severity: critical, error, warning, info, debug (default: warning)

flags.name: --subsystem
flags.description: Filter by subsystem: Boosts, Stats, Thoth, Osiris, RootTemplates, Localization, Assets

flags.name: --mod
flags.description: Filter and correlate errors to a specific mod slug in my_mods/

flags.name: --list-logs
flags.description: List all discovered session logs and exit
